items.title: Lumentum Showcases 3.2T Co-Packaged Optics at ECOC 2026

paragraphs.text: At ECOC 2026, Lumentum demonstrated a 3.2T co-packaged optics prototype in a live switch demo.
The platform is ramping to volume production and has already received volume orders from customers.
